utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey — I can lend those out for the repair drive. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll take you up on tape and screws today, and I’ll check for gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey — tape, screws, and gloves should cover a lot of the small fixes. Just swing by when you’re ready, and I’ll hand them over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Kira — I’m still sorting out my schedule and transport, so I can’t confirm yet. If I can make the logistics work, I’d love to join.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re not confirmed yet, right? Just let me know once you’ve got the logistics sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s right — I’m not confirmed yet. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the schedule and transport sorted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know as soon as the repair drive plan is set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Just let me know when the plan’s set, since I might miss a few updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll make sure you get the final repair drive plan सीधे once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect, Mara — 3:00 to 5:30 should catch both pickup and drop-off nicely. Let me know once you’ve checked the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check the school schedule and let you know as soon as I’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — appreciate you checking. Once you’ve confirmed it, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane—tape and screws would be a big help, and gloves if you can find them too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring tape, screws, and gloves, and I’ll be there Saturday morning by the old garage.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks, Dane — Saturday morning at the old garage works.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s right — from what I’ve heard, they’re still in the collecting-and-sorting phase, not the actual fixing yet. Once the pile of tools and parts looks good, I’d expect the repairs to kick off pretty soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll keep that 3:00 to 5:30 window in mind and check the school schedule so it won’t conflict with pickup. I’ll let you know once I’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh great, thanks — that should make it easier to line everything up. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep passing along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, let’s use the community center parking lot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works well — the community center parking lot should give us plenty of space. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I lock in the date and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the date and repair list when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you check what tools we still need and I’ll sort the donations first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check what tools we still need and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — take your time, and if you want, I can help sort out the ride once you check your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll check my schedule and let you know. If I hear the date and repair list from Rosa, I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — thanks, Nell. I’ll keep a spot open, and once Rosa shares the date and repair list, I’m happy to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ve got it down: the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — 10 at the community center parking lot works for me. I’ll bring gloves and a couple of basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got you down for 10 at the community center parking lot. Thanks for bringing gloves and tools!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana — should I bring the hammer, screwdriver set, and pliers first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please bring those first. Then I’ll double-check the date, time, and address with you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring those first. Just send me the date, time, and address when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great — let’s sort the donations first, then we can check which tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — let’s start with the donations, then we’ll see what tools are missing. I’m still aiming for around 10.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll keep sorting, and if we’re short on anything I’ll make a quick list to fill the gaps.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
